question_text: Compare a fixed-capacity contiguous array with a singly linked list whose nodes are allocated on demand, for a changing number of jobs.
adaptation_rationale: Allocation/resizing and trade-offs explicit; avoid source over generalization all dynamic structures are sequential. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Array has fixed capacity, linked list grows/shrinks as nodes are allocated/freed. Array permits direct indexed access; linked list follows references. Linked list needs per-node links but avoids reserving unused array slots.

marking_points.criterion: Paired fixed capacity versus on-demand growth.
Paired direct indexing versus traversal for these named structures.
Paired storage trade-off: reserved slots versus per-node reference overhead.
